mapper.update: UPDATE I_Repair SET Rp_ReUserID = NULLIF(#{rpReUserId}, ''), Rp_ReDate = CASE WHEN NULLIF(#{rpReDateText}, '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONVERT(date, #{rpReDateText}) END, Rp_JobUserID = NULLIF(#{rpJobUserId}, ''), Rp_ReRemark = #{rpReRemark}, Rp_ReFlag = #{rpReFlag}, Rp_Sign1 = NULLIF(#{rpSign1}, ''), Rp_EXDate = CASE WHEN NULLIF(#{rpExDateText}, '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONVERT(datetime, #{rpExDateText}) END, Rp_Sign2 = NULLIF(#{rpSign2}, '') WHERE Rp_Date = #{rpDate} AND Rp_Number = #{rpNumber} AND ISNULL(Rp_ReFlag, 1) = 1
